# Sources · symmetry

The syllabus lines quoted in the lesson come from S1 only (wording and page numbers as transcribed from the PDF for docs/79 §1.1).
The research references S3–S6 name where the misconceptions come from; they are listed as given in docs/79 and are not yet
checked against the articles (page ranges unchecked are left out). No data, figures or wording are taken from them.
